statement: For infinitely many n, ten permutation graphs give a degree<=20 labelled multigraph with >=n/100 edges across every n/3..2n/3 cut. Delete ALL loops; retain parallel edge labels and each DISTINCT neighbour catalyst ONCE. Spin species X_i+/- and labelled agreement species E_e^(same/different), each occupancy one, admit O(n) bounded-locality reversible original reactions with 0/1 source/product and actual class exactly the 2^n consistent spin configurations. With spin/different activities1 and same activity K=2^400, conditional Poisson is pi(sigma) proportional K^agree; balanced-band mass<=2^(-3n-1), all-plus pi(u)>=2^-n. Any allowed catalytic copy still flips one spin and, with coefficient<=1, has enabled intensity<=1; total<=J physical labels. Exact stationarity implies P_t(u,x)<=pi(x)/pi(u), so expected firings starting in the balanced band by T<=TJ 2^(-2n-1). Reaching the opposite phase must cross this band; TV<=1/8 therefore requires TJ>=2^(2n-3) for large n. W=O(n) at fixed K,epsilon, description O(n log n): uniform polynomial J and T are impossible without complexity assumptions. Fixed-network preprocessing/constants may be exponential in n and are not contradicted. No claim for new edges, block moves, different auxiliary-state target or coefficients above one.
